A simple crane is shown in the below diagram, consisted of light rods with length $1 \mathrm{~m}$ and $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}$. The end of the crane is supporting a $5 \mathrm{kN}$ object. Point $B$ is known as a "pin." It is attached to the main body and can exert both a vertical and horizontal force. Point $A$ is known as a "roller" and can only exert vertical forces. Rods can only be in pure compression or pure tension.
<image_1>

In $\mathrm{kN}$, what is the force experienced by the rod $C D$ ? Express a positive number if the member is in tension and a negative number if it is in compression.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a planar truss crane structure composed of horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonal members; the lower-left support is labeled A and is a roller support, and the lower-right support is labeled B and is a pin support. On the right vertical column there are two adjacent labeled joints C and D, and member CD is the vertical member between them. Directly to the left of D there is a joint at the same height; there is a horizontal member between this joint and D, and there is a diagonal member from this left joint to C. A 5 kN load is suspended at the end of the left boom. Reading from the unit grid in the figure, the line of action of the suspended load is 2 horizontal spans of 1 m to the left of the joint to the left of D; the line of action of CD is at a horizontal distance of 1 m from this left joint. Reasoning: According to the specified method of sections, cut three members: CD, the horizontal member from D to its left joint, and the diagonal member from the joint to the left of D to C, and take the upper/left part as the free body. Taking moments about the joint to the left of D, the lines of action of both the horizontal cut member and the diagonal cut member pass through this point, so they produce no moment. The moment arm of the 5 kN load is 2 m; the perpendicular moment arm from the line of action of the axial force in member CD to this point is 1 m. Moment equilibrium gives F_CD(1) = 5(2), so F_CD = 10 kN. This result corresponds to the assumed tensile-force direction, so it is positive.

raw_record.question_text:
A simple crane is shown in the diagram, consisting of light rods with length $1 \mathrm{~m}$ and $\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}$. The end of the crane is supporting a $5 \mathrm{kN}$ object. Point $B$ is known as a "pin." It is attached to the main body and can exert both a vertical and horizontal force. Point $A$ is known as a "roller" and can only exert vertical forces. Rods can only be in pure compression or pure tension.

In $\mathrm{kN}$, what is the force experienced by the rod $CD$? Express a positive number if the member is in tension and a negative number if it is in compression.

method.method_draft: Use a direct method-of-sections cut. First read the diagram as a unit-square truss: A is the lower-left support, B is the lower-right support, C and D are consecutive joints on the right vertical column, and member CD is the vertical rod between them. The joint directly left of D is one 1 m bay left of D, and C is one 1 m bay above D. The hanging 5 kN load is two 1 m horizontal bays to the left of that left-of-D joint. Cut the truss through three members: CD, the horizontal member from D to the left vertical column, and the diagonal from the left-of-D joint up to C. Isolate the upper/left portion of the truss. Take moments about the left-of-D joint; the horizontal cut member and the diagonal cut member have lines of action passing through that point, so they contribute no moment. The 5 kN load has a 2 m lever arm, while the force in CD has a 1 m lever arm. Moment equilibrium gives F_CD * 1 = 5 * 2 = 10 kN, with the assumed tensile direction giving a positive result.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是由水平、竖直和45度斜杆组成的平面桁架起重结构；下端左侧支座标为 A，是滚轮支座，下端右侧支座标为 B，是铰支座。右侧竖直柱上有相邻的两个标注节点 C 和 D，杆 CD 是它们之间的竖直杆。D 的正左方有一个同高度节点，该节点与 D 之间有水平杆，并且从该左侧节点到 C 有一根斜杆。左侧吊臂末端悬挂 5 kN 载荷。按图中单位方格读数，悬挂载荷的作用线在 D 左侧那个节点的左方 2 个 1 m 水平跨距处；CD 的作用线距该左侧节点水平距离为 1 m。

推理：按指定截面法，切开三根杆：CD、D 到其左侧节点的水平杆、以及 D 左侧节点到 C 的斜杆，并取上部/左部为隔离体。对 D 左侧节点取矩时，水平切杆和斜切杆的作用线都通过该点，所以不产生力矩。5 kN 载荷的力臂为 2 m；杆 CD 的轴力作用线到该点的垂直力臂为 1 m。取矩平衡得 F_CD(1) = 5(2)，所以 F_CD = 10 kN。该结果对应假设拉力方向，因此为正值。

method.method_draft: Set up and solve the complete pin-joint equilibrium system. First describe the image as a truss made of unit horizontal/vertical rods and sqrt(2) diagonal rods, so the diagonals are at 45 degrees. Assign coordinates to the visible joints, for example A = (0,0), B = (1,0), D = (1,2), C = (1,3), with the rest of the tower and boom joints placed on the same unit grid according to the diagram. Treat every rod force as an unknown positive in tension. Include the support reactions A_y only at A and B_x, B_y at B, and apply the 5 kN downward load at the left end of the crane. Write sum Fx = 0 and sum Fy = 0 at every joint using direction cosines: horizontal/vertical members have components 1 or 0, and diagonal members have components ±1/sqrt(2). Solve the resulting linear system, then read off the unknown corresponding to the vertical member between C and D. The solved value is +10 kN, so CD is in tension.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是由水平、竖直单位杆和45°斜杆组成的平面桁架起重机。右侧是竖直塔架，底部左支座为A滚轮、底部右支座为B铰支座；右侧竖杆上标出D在C的下方，且CD是右侧竖向构件。左端吊着5 kN重物。按图中方格取坐标：A=(0,0), B=(1,0), D=(1,2), C=(1,3)，右塔架其余节点位于同一单位网格上，斜杆均为sqrt(2)长度，因此方向余弦为±1/sqrt(2)。
推理：把所有杆力设为未知量，正号表示拉力。支座反力为A_y、B_x、B_y，外力为左端节点5 kN向下。整体平衡先给出支座反力：sum F_x=0得B_x=0；对A取矩，左端荷载在x=-2处产生+10 kN·m力矩，所以B_y+10=0，得B_y=-10 kN；sum F_y=0得A_y+B_y-5=0，所以A_y=15 kN。然后按节点平衡解线性方程。底部节点B：sum F_y=0给F_{BR1}+B_y=0，所以F_{BR1}=10 kN；sum F_x=0给F_{AB}=0。节点A：sum F_x=0使斜杆A-R1的力为0；sum F_y=0给F_{A-L1}=-15 kN。节点L1：由竖向平衡得F_{L1-L2}=-15 kN，由水平平衡得F_{L1-R1}=0。节点R1：已知向下的BR1为10 kN，且水平杆、斜杆为0，因此竖杆R1-D满足F_{R1D}=10 kN。最后看节点D，节点D连接R1-D、D-C和水平杆L2-D。该节点没有水平外力，因此F_{L2D}=0；竖向平衡为F_{CD}-F_{R1D}=0，所以F_{CD}=10 kN。正号表示CD受拉。

Image description: The figure shows a planar truss crane structure composed of horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree diagonal members; the lower-left support is labeled A and is a roller support, and the lower-right support is labeled B and is a pin support. On the right vertical column there are two adjacent labeled joints C and D, and member CD is the vertical member between them. Directly to the left of D there is a joint at the same height; there is a horizontal member between this joint and D, and there is a diagonal member from this left joint to C. A 5 kN load is suspended at the end of the left boom. Reading from the unit grid in the figure, the line of action of the suspended load is 2 horizontal spans of 1 m to the left of the joint to the left of D; the line of action of CD is at a horizontal distance of 1 m from this left joint.

Reasoning: According to the specified method of sections, cut three members: CD, the horizontal member from D to its left joint, and the diagonal member from the joint to the left of D to C, and take the upper/left part as the free body. Taking moments about the joint to the left of D, the lines of action of both the horizontal cut member and the diagonal cut member pass through this point, so they produce no moment. The moment arm of the 5 kN load is 2 m; the perpendicular moment arm from the line of action of the axial force in member CD to this point is 1 m. Moment equilibrium gives F_CD(1) = 5(2), so F_CD = 10 kN. This result corresponds to the assumed tensile-force direction, so it is positive.

It first describes the diagram and then reasons, correctly identifies member CD, the adjacent left joint, the relevant cut members, the 2 m and 1 m moment arms, and reaches the standard answer +10 kN. Minor optional improvement: explicitly state the assumed tensile force direction on the isolated free body before concluding the positive sign.

Trace is generally valid and consistent with the diagram and standard answer. Minor improvements: explicitly define the auxiliary node names L1, L2, R1 before using them, and at node R1 explicitly mention the additional diagonal member from L2 to R1 and show that its force is zero from horizontal equilibrium. Also, the method draft calls for a complete pin-joint system; the trace instead uses global equilibrium plus a local joint-by-joint shortcut, which is acceptable but should be described as a reduced equilibrium solution rather than a full-system solve.
